scope: Discrete seven-arm module C; no time-series/unknown-reference end-to-end performance claim
paired_scenarios: same covariates, user effects and potential outcomes noise within a seed; not five independent replicates
estimand: finite covariate-sample average potential-outcome contrast relative to zero dose; latent user intercept cancels
outcome_model: Separate Ridge(alpha=1) per arm with training-only standardized quadratic pre-treatment covariates
propensity_model: Training-only standardized linear covariates, multinomial LogisticRegression(C=1,max_iter=2000)

diagnostics.explanation: finite-sample prespecified screening, not proof of ignorability; 0.2 is this protocol's screen, not RIDE's 0.1 default

inference: centered user score sums with G/(G-1) finite-cluster factor; 999 Gaussian cluster multiplier draws; 95% simultaneous six-contrast band

threshold.output: all feasible first grid-crossing indices and not-reached flag; never automatic monotone tightening

no_selection: No main-test hyperparameter tuning, rerunning for better scores, or post hoc method selection
failure_policy: Insufficient support returns identified=false and no reportable causal band/threshold; internal raw estimates retained only for audit
identification_assumptions: pre-treatment observed X sufficient for treatment assignment in observational scenarios
boundary: All outcomes simulated. No real behavior, no hidden-confounding robustness claim, no complete B1/103 acceptance. Standard AIPW is a mature method adaptation, not a new causal estimator.
